scripts.db:migrate: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @disclo/db run migrate:dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @disclo/db run migrate:deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @disclo/db run db:seed
scripts.db:studio: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @disclo/db run studio
scripts.smoke:bullmq: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @disclo/workers run smoke:bullmq
